hooks.name: permission-guard
hooks.description: Unattended runs: approves shell commands and file edits that stay inside the repository and match no risky pattern (force push, reset --hard, deletions outside the repo, printing or editing .env, system paths, remote code). Anything else keeps Kiro's normal approval prompt. Script: .kiro/hooks/scripts/permission-guard.ps1, tests: permission-guard.test.ps1.
